meaning: Finite interpretations for the uniting-cause and in-act forks: exclusivity and coverage omission models for both joint theorems, the mixed in-act reading with self-motion, and a nonvacuity witness per joint theorem. Omission models for the remaining premises are not repeated here; COMPOSITE-UNITING-CAUSE-CONTROLS and the prima via controls give them for the efficient and single-InAct instances of the same premises. Satisfiability and omission only; no model describes reality.
